cases.name: start_only
cases.prompt: A single small grey needle-felt mouse Milo sits on the grass beside the stream, holding one acorn in both paws. He gently brings the acorn toward his mouth, nibbles, and lowers it, with a small natural head nod. His feet stay planted. Fixed camera, unchanged framing and mouse size, softly flowing stream, warm afternoon light, felt storybook animation.
cases.negative_prompt: extra animals, extra limbs, deformed paws, face distortion, changing identity, camera movement, zoom, cuts, flicker, text, subtitles
